summary: src/ui2/theme.rs ports the Iced theme (colour constants, spacing/padding, text sizes, slot tint/ink model, container frames, and a global egui Style/Visuals setup) with names and exact values preserved; all 9 ported theme tests pass against real egui 0.36.2 in a scoped #[path] harness because the module is not yet registered in src/ui2/mod.rs, which is outside this task's ownership.

tests.command: cargo test --manifest-path %TEMP%/kilo/t2-theme-harness/Cargo.toml (harness #[path]-includes the real src/ui2/theme.rs against egui 0.36.2 with a SocdMode stub mirroring src/settings.rs)
cargo test --locked --all-targets (full gate, default features: 72 lib + 60 integration)
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings (full gate, default features)
cargo test --locked --no-default-features --features egui-ui --lib --bin lastkey-settings (105 lib tests)

tests_actually_executed_note: The 9 theme tests (immediate/random_mix/press_delay/release_delay tints, opacity, idle ink, name-box hover, mode label ink, hover-vs-active distinguishability) executed and passed ONLY in the #[path] harness. The crate-level egui-ui run executed the 105 Wave 0 tests and cannot see theme.rs until it is registered; it is reported as pass for the tree, not as execution of the theme tests.

constant_accounting.ported_same_name_same_value: All named constants of src/ui/theme.rs: 46 colour constants (incl. the previously private CANVAS/SURFACE/INSET/BORDER/INDIGO_50-400/VIOLET_50-400/NAME_HOVER_*/ERROR_BG/ERROR_BORDER, widened to pub because egui has no central style closures to consume them), UI_FONT and MONO_FONT (as FontFamily::Proportional/Monospace), BODY_TEXT_SIZE, HEADING_SIZE, PAGE_PADDING, SECTION_GAP, ROW_GAP, CARD_PADDING, GROUP_PADDING, BUTTON_PADDING(_WIDE), HEADER_ICON_PADDING/HEIGHT, MODE_PADDING, PROFILE_PANEL_WIDTH, LANGUAGE_PANEL_WIDTH, PANEL_PADDING, PROFILE_HEADER_PADDING, PROFILE_SCROLLER_PADDING, LANGUAGE_SCROLLER_PADDING, SLOT_GAP, LANGUAGE_ROW_GAP, SLOT_ROW_GAP, SLOT_CARD_PADDING, SLOT_NAME_PADDING, SLOT_NAME_GAP, SLOT_NAME_INPUT_PADDING, PROFILE_HEADER_GAP, CHIP_SIZE, CHIP_GAP, CHIP_PADDING, CHIP_CONTENT_MIN, PRESS_*/RELEASE_* SlotTint consts, SlotState/SlotTint/SlotInk/KeycapMode, over/dim/accent_tint/ramp_tint/slot_tint/slot_ink/slot_ink_hovering/slot_mode_ink, shade.

omitted_with_reason.UI_FONT_BOLD, UI_FONT_SEMIBOLD, UI_FONT_: egui 0.36 selects faces by FontFamily + registered variant; eframe's default_fonts ships no bold/semibold/italic/black faces, so there is no value-preserving counterpart. The generic families they derived from (UI_FONT, MONO_FONT) are ported; weight emphasis is raised as a behaviour question (migration constraint 5), not decided here.
omitted_with_reason.iced style closures (canvas_style..value: Container styles ported as same-named egui::Frame builders (values embedded verbatim). Widget-state closures (buttons/slider/toggler/text_input/rule) have no egui counterpart mechanism - egui styles widgets at the call site - so their state-independent literals are exposed as named constants (CARD_BORDER, HOVER_WASH, KEYCAP_HOVER_BG/BORDER, KEYCAP_REBIND_EDGE, ACTIVE_OPTION_BG/HOVER_BG, TEXT_SELECTION, DIRTY_BADGE_BG/EDGE, CONFIRM_OVERLAY_FILL, SHADOW_*, *_RADIUS, SLIDER_* geometry) and each closure's disposition is documented in style()'s doc comment.

integration_prereq: Add `pub mod theme;` to src/ui2/mod.rs (one line, outside T2 ownership). Until then the crate build/test/clippy never read theme.rs and the 9 theme tests do not run in the repo gate; after registration the egui-ui lib run should report 114 tests. T3-T6 should import tokens from ui2::theme instead of re-inlining hexes.
risks: Style::light() does not exist in egui 0.36.2; the global style() builds Style { visuals: Visuals::light(), ..Default::default() }. Widgets fields are hovered (not hovering), WidgetVisuals uses corner_radius (not rounding), and there is no disabled colour set (Visuals::disabled_alpha fades instead) - the reference's disabled pair (SLATE_300 ink on SURFACE) is exposed as constants and must be applied by view modules where controls can actually be disabled.

f32 alphas (0.04/0.05/0.06/0.12/0.15/0.25/0.4/0.7/0.9/0.95) are stored as nearest 8-bit bytes (10/13/15/31/38/64/102/179/230/242); the module header lists every quantization. Screen output is unchanged by construction (8-bit display), but a pixel-diff harness comparing against float alphas would see sub-LSB differences.

style()'s global Visuals mapping (outlined-control hover/press pattern on widgets.hovered/active, BODY_TEXT ink, CONTROL_RADIUS) is a conservative baseline derived from the Iced closures' shared Hovered|Pressed grouping; individual filled variants (primary indigo, warning amber, selected mode segment, keycap accents) deliberately stay call-site concerns of T3-T6.
T3/T4 compile the same crate concurrently in separate worktrees; no breakage from their files was observed in this worktree (tree at 8ad8457 + 1053066, both builds green).

If the Integrator registers theme.rs and any view file later references a name not present here (e.g. mode_color accents live in app:: per the old comment), that is a finding for the owning task, not a reason to duplicate the value in theme.rs.
